name: Paint Your Own Pumpkin!
org: Grayslake Area Chamber of Commerce / Village Center
raw: Paint Your Own Pumpkin! | 2026-10-10 10:00AM-12:00PM | Yhana Boba Cafe | Tired of cleaning up all the pumpkin mess year after year? Stop into YHANA and paint yours completely free! All you need to do is bring your own pumpkin and they’ll have all the supplies! FREE event!
notes: Yhana Boba Cafe; bring your own pumpkin

name: Abraham Lincoln: A New Birth of Freedom
raw:
Abraham Lincoln: A New Birth of Freedom | 2026-10-16 6:00PM-7:00PM | Grayslake Heritage Center & Museum | As part of Grayslake’s USA 250 events, the Grayslake Heritage Center & Museum welcomes Kevin Wood who portrays President Abraham Lincoln. 
 Wood will cover the entire period from Independence through the Civil War and Mr. Lincoln’s inspiring personal story.
 Free event. No registration required.

name: The Cadillac of Fire Trucks
raw:
The Cadillac of Fire Trucks | 2026-10-20 7:00PM-8:00PM | Grayslake Heritage Center & Museum | In conjunction to the Grayslake Fire & Rescue exhibit at the Grayslake Heritage Center & Museum, they invite you to their upcoming program, “The Cadillac of Fire Trucks”. Bob Lichter of the Kenosha Historical Society will present a history of Pirsch Fire Trucks.
 Free event. No registration required
notes: History talk on Pirsch fire trucks; adult-leaning
